summary: A button dressed as a field, for things that open a picker — a date, a filter.

pairs.dont: Fake a picker trigger with a read-only input.
pairs.why: A read-only input is announced as a text field that cannot be edited — the opposite of what it does. A button with aria-expanded says what it is.

pairs.dont: Show 'Select…' in the same colour as a chosen value.
pairs.do: Pass value, and let placeholder render in the placeholder colour when it is empty.
pairs.why: Empty and filled must be distinguishable at a glance, exactly as they are in an Input.

a11y: A real <button>; set aria-expanded when it controls a popover (Radix triggers do this). The chevron turns with it.
